LOOK: Sixty-four-year-old rice farmer Roberto Abanilla of Kabacan town, North Cotabato, harvests the remaining crops from his half-hectare farm on Monday, May 4, after portions of his rice field were affected by flooding caused by heavy rains in the past nights.

Abanilla, who has been farming for 10 years, said he expects to harvest around 92 sacks of cereal grains twice a year, but he cannot say how many as of today. He added that he had also prepared for the possible effects of El Niño. 📸 Ivy Tejano / MB

PGMN Anchor Atty. Regal Oliva, a Cebu-based lawyer known for breaking down complex issues into digestible insights, has made history as the first anchor in PGMN to surpass 2 million followers on Facebook.

Oliva, who also made history as the first transgender woman to serve as president of the Cebu Lady Lawyers Association, is known for her sharp legal commentary and public advocacy.

One of her most viewed PGMN episodes tackled the International Criminal Court (ICC) case against former President Rodrigo Duterte, where she examined detention without conviction, due process concerns and jurisdictional issues surrounding the case.

Another viral breakdown focused on the absence of divorce laws in the Philippines, offering a critical look at how existing legislation fails to protect individuals in abusive or broken marriages.

Watch the full episode here:
https://t.co/w3xw7sOduG

Oliva's growing social media following reflects her expanding influence, as she continues to engage millions of Filipinos, sharing her expertise and championing causes that matter.

For more of Atty. Regal Oliva’s legal insights and thought leadership, visit her Facebook page here: https://t.co/bvunJ6akuu

‘SHE RALLIED WITH AND FOR FILIPINOS’

Ipinagtanggol ni Miss Philippines Earth 2025 Joy Barcoma si Miss Universe Philippines 2026 Bea Millan-Windorski laban sa mga bumabatikos online, iginiit na hindi ito oportunista at tunay na may malasakit sa bansa.

Ayon kay Barcoma, mismong si Bea pa umano ang nagtanong kung saan siya maaaring sumali sa mga protesta at aktibong nakikiisa sa mga isyung kinahaharap ng mga Pilipino.

Dagdag pa niya, hindi dapat kwestiyunin ang pagiging Pilipino ng beauty queen, dahil aniya, mas naipapakita pa nito ang malasakit kumpara sa iba na kahit nasa bansa ay hindi man lang makapagsalita o makipaglaban para dito.

Matatandaang kinoronahan si Bea bilang Miss Universe Philippines 2026 nitong Sabado, Mayo 2.
